research_questions: Can a backdoor-aware client detector improve malicious-client recall under low-rate trigger poisoning while preserving benign-client precision?
Can a separately calibrated backdoor-aware reconstruction policy reduce triggered ASR consistently across triggers and seeds?
Does the extension remain effective against detector-aware and reconstruction-aware adaptive attackers?

hypotheses.H1_detection: Mean malicious-client recall >= 0.50 and maximum benign-client FPR <= 0.05.
hypotheses.H2_mitigation: For each confirmatory trigger family, mean triggered ASR reduction >= 25% relative to exact paired FedAvg and improvement in at least 3 of 4 seeds.
hypotheses.H3_clean_utility: Mean clean validation macro-F1 loss <= 0.01 and no seed loss > 0.02.
hypotheses.H4_adaptive_robustness: Under adaptive attacks, positive ASR reduction in at least 3 of 4 seeds, mean malicious-client recall >= 0.35, and maximum benign-client FPR <= 0.05.

defense_candidates.description: Unchanged Task 40 detector plus center_plus_residual reconstruction.
Client score from class-conditional prediction shifts on frozen triggered server probes.
Client-update alignment with target-class trigger-gradient directions.
Equal-weight rank fusion of frozen Task 40 score, D1, and D2.

staged_execution.gate: All preregistration checks pass and commit is created

staged_execution.allowed: Clean warmup, independent anchor, and validation only
staged_execution.gate: Thresholds and transforms frozen without attack labels

staged_execution.allowed: All preregistered candidates on seed 7 only
staged_execution.gate: One defense selected by lexicographic rule

staged_execution.allowed: Selected defense, all frozen seeds, A1 and A2
Selected defense, all frozen seeds, A3 and A4
Reserved tests only after all choices are frozen and committed
staged_execution.gate: Single final evaluation, no subsequent retuning

steps: Reject candidate if mean clean macro-F1 loss > 0.01 or any seed-7 round loss > 0.02.
Among survivors, maximize mean malicious-client recall across all A1 seed-7 conditions.
Break ties by larger mean relative ASR reduction.
Break remaining ties by lower runtime overhead.
If no candidate survives, record failure and do not invent a new candidate inside Task 41C.

statistics.pairing: Exact paired plain-versus-defense by trigger, poison fraction, seed, partition, warmup, poison plan, and round
statistics.hypothesis_tests: Exact paired sign-flip tests where sample count permits
statistics.multiple_comparison_control: Holm correction within each hypothesis family

prohibited_posthoc_changes: Using reserved test arrays for development
Adding a defense after observing confirmatory outcomes
stopping_rules: Stop immediately if any reserved test array is accessed before C5.
Stop if exact-pair hashes differ between plain and defended branches.
Stop if protocol files change after the C0 freeze commit.
Stop candidate development if all preregistered candidates fail the selection rule.
Do not continue to final testing unless C3 and C4 are complete and frozen.
